description_en: You can call the CreateCloudBenchTasks operation to create a stress testing task
description_zh: 调用CreateCloudBenchTasks接口，创建压测任务
kebab_example: aliyun das create-cloud-bench-tasks --task-type pressure_test --src-instance-id rm-2ze1jdv45i7l60000 --description test-das-bench-0501 --client-type ECS --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudBenchTasks

parameters.help_en:
The type of stress testing task. Valid values:

pressure test (default): Intelligent stress testing, which replays the traffic captured from the source instance on the target instance at the maximum speed supported by the target instance type.

smart pressure test: Generated stress testing, which analyzes and learns from the traffic captured from the source instance in a short period of time, generates traffic that is consistent with the business model and traffic distribution of the original traffic for continuous stress testing, reduces the time for collecting data from the source instance, and reduces storage costs and performance overhead
parameters.help_zh:
压测任务类型。取值：
pressure test（默认）：智能压测，将从源实例上捕获的流量，按照目标实例规格支持的极限速度，在目标实例上进行回放。
smart pressure test：生成压测，通过分析和学习短时间内在源实例上捕获的流量，生成和原始流量的业务模型和流量分布基本一致的流量进行持续压测，减少从源实例采集数据的时间，降低存储成本和性能开销
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance. Only RDS MySQL and PolarDB MySQL instances are supported. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202857.html operation to obtain the ID.

This parameter is required when DstType is set to Instance
parameters.help_zh:
源实例ID，仅支持RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL版实例，您可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202857.html接口获取。
当DstType为Instance时，本参数需要传入
parameters.name: src_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the stress testing task
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数
parameters.name: src_public_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target instance. Only RDS MySQL and PolarDB MySQL instances are supported. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202857.html operation to obtain the ID.

This parameter is required when DstType is set to Instance
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例ID，仅支持RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL版实例，您可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202857.html接口获取。
当DstType为Instance时，本参数需要传入
parameters.name: dst_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the Database Gateway.

This parameter is required when ClientType is set to ECS
parameters.help_zh:
数据库网关的专有网络ID。
若ClientType取值为ECS，则此参数必传入
parameters.name: gateway_vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address or domain name of the Database Gateway.

This parameter is required when ClientType is set to ECS
parameters.help_zh:
数据库网关的IP地址或域名。
若ClientType取值为ECS，则此参数必传入
parameters.name: gateway_vpc_ip

parameters.help_en:
The type of stress testing machine. Valid values:

ECS: You need to prepare a https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64905.html yourself.

DAS_ECS: An ECS instance that is automatically purchased and deployed by DAS
parameters.help_zh:
压测机器类型。取值：

ECS：您需要自己准备https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64905.html。
DAS_ECS：DAS自动购买和部署的ECS
parameters.name: client_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the stress testing task. The time is in the UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: request_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the stress testing task. The time is in the UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: request_end_time

parameters.help_en: The duration of the stress testing task. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务的持续时间，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: request_duration

parameters.help_en: The replay speed of the source instance traffic on the target instance. The replay speed must be a positive integer. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 源实例流量在目标实例上的回放速度，回放速度必须是正整数，取值：1~30，默认为1
parameters.name: rate

parameters.help_en:
The duration of the generated stress testing. Unit: milliseconds.

This parameter is required when TaskType is set to smart pressure test
parameters.help_zh:
生成压测的持续时间，单位为毫秒。
当TaskType为smart pressure test时本参数需要传入
parameters.name: smart_pressure_time

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the DTS migration task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/230669.html operation to obtain the specification.

The stress testing task needs to migrate the baseline data from the source instance to the target instance. This parameter is required when you create a new DTS task
parameters.help_zh:
DTS迁移任务规格，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/230669.html接口获取。
压测任务需要先将源实例基准数据迁移至目标实例，当您新建DTS任务时需要传入本参数
parameters.name: dts_job_class

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DTS migration task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208399.html operation to obtain the ID.

This parameter is required when a DTS task has been created in the DTS console
parameters.help_zh:
DTS迁移任务ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208399.html接口获取。
已在DTS控制台创建完DTS任务时本参数必传入
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The privileged account of the source instance. Value: admin.

This parameter is required when DstType is set to Instance
parameters.help_zh:
源端实例高权限账号。取值：admin。
当DstType为Instance时，本参数需要传入
parameters.name: src_super_account

parameters.help_en:
The password of the privileged account of the source instance.

This parameter is required when DstType is set to Instance
parameters.help_zh:
源端实例高权限账号的密码。
当DstType为Instance时，本参数需要传入
parameters.name: src_super_password

parameters.help_en: The privileged account of the target instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例的高权限账号
parameters.name: dst_super_account

parameters.help_en: The password of the privileged account of the target instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例高权限账号的密码
parameters.name: dst_super_password

parameters.help_en:
The type of the target instance. Valid values:

Instance (default): instance ID.

ConnectionString: connection address of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的类型。取值：
Instance（默认）：实例ID。
ConnectionString：实例的连接地址
parameters.name: dst_type

parameters.help_en:
The connection address of the target instance. Only RDS MySQL and PolarDB MySQL instances are supported.

This parameter takes effect when DstType is set to ConnectionString
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的连接地址，仅支持RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL版实例。
DstType为ConnectionString本参数有效
parameters.name: dst_connection_string

parameters.help_en:
The port of the target instance.

This parameter takes effect when DstType is set to ConnectionString
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的端口。
DstType为ConnectionString本参数有效
parameters.name: dst_port

parameters.help_en: The temporary directory generated by the stress testing
parameters.help_zh: 压测生成的临时目录
parameters.name: work_dir

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html operation to query the backup list and obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 备份集ID，可通过查询备份列表接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html获取
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The time of the backup. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time)
parameters.help_zh: 备份的时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: backup_time

parameters.help_en: The total number of stress testing tasks to create. Valid values: 0 to 30. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 创建压测任务的总个数，取值：0~30，默认为1
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en:
The status after the stress testing task ends. Valid values:

WAIT_TARGET: Prepare the target instance for stress testing.

WAIT_DBGATEWAY: Prepare the stress testing deployment.

WAIT_SQL: Prepare the full SQL statements.

WAIT_LOGIC: Prepare to start replaying the traffic.

When the stress testing task completes the status set by EndState, the task directly reaches the completed status
parameters.help_zh:
压测任务结束后的状态。取值：

WAIT_TARGET：准备压测的目标实例。
WAIT_DBGATEWAY：准备压测部署。
WAIT_SQL：准备全量SQL。
WAIT_LOGIC：准备开始回放流量。

当压测任务执行完EndState设置的状态之后，任务将直接到达完成状态
parameters.name: end_state
